title: Affine sections of a relatively flat quasi-coherent module are flat
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $B$ be an $A$-algebra, and let $M$ be a $B$-module. If for every prime $\mathfrak q$ of $B$, with inverse image $\mathfrak p$ in $A$, the localized module $M_{\mathfrak q}$ is flat over $A_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], then $M$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
